meta.title: Slim workbench
meta.description:
Stop hopping between five terminals.

Node versions, frontend dev servers, backend Spring Boot — one sidebar panel shows what is running, on which port, on which branch, under which Node. It opens instantly and never starts anything by itself.

**It does not touch your project**: the folder is read-only, both git calls carry `--no-optional-locks` so `.git/index` is never rewritten, a pinned Node version affects that launch only (never your global `nvm use`), and Stop kills the whole process tree — while a host crash can still be recovered, because the next start adopts runs by pid plus command line.

Install: Plugin Manager → Plugins → Add → **Enable**.
